q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of particle board per square metre?
title: Particle board carbon footprint per sq m
short: Add the wood chips or agri residue and resin per square metre with supplier figures, then the dryer, press and sanding energy. Divide the plant's energy by square metres dispatched, and state thickness and density.
audience: Particle board and prelaminated board makers

ul: Wood chips, sawdust or bagasse by weight.
Chip dryer, often fired by wood dust.

p: Report per square metre at its thickness. A 25 mm board carries far more wood and resin than an 8 mm one.

example.title: Worked example: particle board unit per sq m (one month)
lines: Plant total: 203,300 / 200,000 = 1.016 kg CO2 per sq m
Add wood and resin for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
